cells.quote: In the control group, the median interpretation and diagnosis scores were 3 points (IQR: 3–4 and 2–4, respectively). In contrast, the intervention group achieved higher median scores, with 6 points for interpretation (IQR: 6–7) and 4 points for diagnosis (IQR: 3–6).
cells.note: Final-year medical students had prior curricular exposure to chest radiography interpretation; students with prior advanced radiology training or experience were excluded.
